Location Services allows Apple and third-party apps and websites to gather and use information based on the current location of your iPad to provide a variety of location-based services. For example, an app might use your location data and location search query to help you find nearby coffee shops or cinemas, or your iPad may set its time zone automatically based on your current location. To use features such as these, you must enable Location Services on your iPad and give your permission to each app or website before it can use your location data. Apps may request limited access to your location data (only when you are using the app) or full access (even when you are not using the app). For safety purposes, however, your iPad’s location information may be used when you place an emergency call to aid response efforts regardless of whether you enable Location Services.

Location Services uses GPS and Bluetooth (where those are available) along with crowd-sourced %2$@ hotspot and mobile phone mast locations to determine your iPad’s approximate location. If Location Services is on, your iPad will periodically send the geo-tagged locations of nearby %2$@ hotspots and mobile phone masts in an anonymous and encrypted form to Apple to be used for augmenting this crowd-sourced database of %2$@ hotspot and mobile phone mast locations. By enabling Location Services, location-based system services such as these will also be enabled:

  • Routing & Traffic.  If you are physically moving (for example, walking or travelling in a car), your iPad will periodically send GPS locations and travel speed information in an anonymous and encrypted form to Apple. This crowd-sourced data is used to provide services such as real-time traffic display and routing.
  • Popular Near Me.  Your iPad will periodically send locations of where and when you have purchased or used apps in an anonymous and encrypted form to Apple to improve a crowd-sourced database that may be used to offer geographically relevant apps and other Apple products and services.
  • Significant Locations.  Your iPad will keep track of places you have recently been, as well as how often and when you visited them, in order to learn places that are significant to you. This data is transmitted end-to-end encrypted between your iCloud-connected devices and will not be shared without your consent. It will be used to provide you with personalised services, such as predictive traffic routing, and to build better Photos Memories.
  • Location-Based Apple Ads.  Your iPad will send your location, including its travel speed and direction, to Apple in order to provide you with geographically relevant iAds.
  • Location-Based Suggestions.  The location of your iPad will be sent to Apple to provide more relevant recommendations. If you turn off Location Services for Location-Based Suggestions, your precise location will not be sent to Apple. To deliver relevant search suggestions and news, Apple may use the IP address of your internet connection to approximate your location by matching it to a geographic region.
  • Location-Based Alerts.  Your iPad will use your location in order to provide you with geographically relevant alerts, such as a reminder to call someone when you get to a specific place, when to leave for your next appointment or an app recommendation based on where you currently are.
  • Share My Location.  You can choose to share your current location with others on a temporary or ongoing basis from within certain apps such as Messages and Find My Friends.
  • HomeKit. Your iPad will use your location to enable accessories to turn on or off when you arrive at or leave a specific location, such as turning on your lights when you get home.

The crowd-sourced location data gathered by Apple does not personally identify you.

By enabling Location Services on your iPad, you agree and consent to the transmission, collection, maintenance, processing and use of your location data and location search queries by Apple and its partners and licensees to provide and improve location-based and road traffic–based products and services.

You may choose to disable Location Services at any time. To do so, open Settings, tap Privacy, tap Location Services, and either turn off the global Location Services switch or turn off the individual location switch of each location-aware app or feature on your iPad by setting it to Never. To disable Location Services for all websites, set the Location Services setting for Safari to Never. You may also disable location-based system services on your iPad by tapping System Services and turning off the switch for each location-based system service on your iPad.

If you allow third-party apps or websites to use your current location, you are subject to their terms, privacy policies and practices. You should review the terms, privacy policies and practices of such apps and websites to understand how they use your location and other information.

Information collected by Apple will be treated in accordance with Apple’s Privacy Policy, which can be found at www.apple.com/uk/privacy.

「定位服務」可讓Apple和第三方的App與網站收集並使用基於iPad目前位置的資訊，以便提供多種基於位置的服務。例如，App可能會使用你的位置資料和搜尋查詢來協助你尋找附近的咖啡店或電影院，又或者iPad可能會根據你目前的所在位置來自動設定時區。若要使用這些功能，你必須啟用iPad上的「定位服務」並授權App或網站使用你的位置資料。在App可能會要求有限制地取用（在你使用App時）或無限制地取用（在你使用或未使用App時）你的位置資訊。為了安全考量，無論是否已啟用「定位服務」，撥打緊急服務電話時，iPad的位置資訊都有可能會用來協助救援行動。

「定位服務」使用GPS和藍牙（若可用）、眾包%2$@熱點和基地台的所在位置來確認iPad的大約位置。若已啟用「定位服務」，iPad會定期將附近%2$@熱點與基地台的地理座標位置，以匿名和加密的格式傳送給Apple，以便加強%2$@熱點與基地台位置的眾包資料庫功能。若啟用了「定位服務」，也會啟用下列基於位置的系統服務：

Le service de localisation permet à Apple et aux apps et sites web de tierce partie de collecter et d’utiliser des informations associées à la position géographique de votre iPad afin d’offrir divers services liés à la localisation. Par exemple, une app peut utiliser vos données de localisation et vos requêtes de recherches géographiques pour vous aider à trouver un café ou un cinéma à proximité ; votre iPad peut aussi régler son fuseau horaire en fonction de votre position géographique. Pour utiliser de telles fonctions, activez le service de localisation sur votre iPad et autorisez chaque app ou site web à utiliser vos données de localisation. Les apps peuvent requérir un accès limité à vos données de localisation (seulement lorsque vous les utilisez) ou un accès complet à celles-ci (même lorsque vous ne les utilisez pas). Cependant, pour des questions de sécurité, les données de localisation de votre iPad peuvent être utilisées lorsque vous passez un appel d’urgence afin d’augmenter les chances de réponse, que le service de localisation soit activé ou non.

Pour déterminer la position approximative de votre iPad, le service de localisation allie le GPS et Bluetooth (si disponibles) à une base de données communautaire des emplacements des bornes d’accès %2$@ et des antennes-relais de téléphonie mobile. Si le service de localisation est activé, votre iPad enverra périodiquement à Apple, sous forme anonyme et chiffrée, les emplacements géotagués des bornes d’accès %2$@ et des antennes-relais de téléphonie mobile situées à proximité afin d’augmenter cette base de données communautaire des emplacements des bornes d’accès %2$@ et des antennes-relais de téléphonie mobile. Si vous activez le service de localisation, les services système de géolocalisation suivants sont également activés :

  • Circulation routière.  Si vous vous déplacez physiquement (par exemple, à pied ou en voiture), votre iPad enverra périodiquement à Apple vos emplacements GPS et vos vitesses de déplacement, sous forme anonyme et chiffrée, de manière à constituer une base de données communautaire de la circulation en temps réel et des itinéraires.
  • Populaire à proximité.  Votre iPad enverra également périodiquement à Apple les données géographiques et temporelles liées à vos achats et à votre utilisation des applications, sous forme anonyme et chiffrée, afin d’améliorer une base de données communautaire permettant d’offrir des applications et des produits et services Apple en rapport avec votre position.
  • Lieux importants.  Votre iPad conservera un historique des lieux que vous avez visités récemment, ainsi que la fréquence et le moment de vos visites, afin de connaître les lieux importants dans votre vie. Ces données sont transmises sous forme chiffrée d’un bout à l’autre entre vos appareils connectés à iCloud et ne seront pas partagées sans votre consentement ; elles serviront par exemple à vous fournir des services personnalisés tels que des itinéraires intuitifs et à créer de meilleurs souvenirs dans Photos.
  • Publicités Apple selon le lieu.  Votre iPad enverra votre position à Apple, notamment votre vitesse de déplacement et votre destination, afin de vous offrir des publicités iAd relatives à votre position.
  • Suggestions selon le lieu.  La position de votre iPad sera transmise à Apple afin de vous fournir des recommandations plus pertinentes. Si vous désactivez le service de localisation pour les suggestions selon le lieu, votre position exacte ne sera pas envoyée à Apple. Pour offrir des suggestions de recherche et des articles pertinents, Apple peut utiliser l’adresse IP de votre connexion Internet afin de la faire correspondre avec une région géographique et déterminer votre position approximative.
  • Alertes selon le lieu.  Votre iPad se servira de votre position pour vous alerter en fonction de certains lieux : rappel d’appeler telle personne en arrivant à tel endroit, signal pour partir de votre lieu actuel afin d’arriver à l’heure à un rendez-vous ou recommandations d’apps en fonction de votre lieu actuel.
  • Partager ma position.  Vous pouvez choisir de partager votre position actuelle, de façon temporaire ou permanente, depuis certaines apps telles que Messages et « Localiser mes amis ».
  • HomeKit. Votre iPad utilisera votre position pour permettre à des accessoires de s’activer ou se désactiver quand vous atteignez ou quittez un certain lieu ; les lumières de votre domicile peuvent par exemple s’allumer lorsque vous rentrez.

Les données communautaires de localisation recueillies par Apple ne vous identifient pas personnellement.

En activant le service de localisation sur votre iPad, vous acceptez et consentez à la transmission, la collecte, la conservation, le traitement et l’utilisation de vos données de localisation et de vos requêtes de recherches géographiques par Apple et ses partenaires et titulaires de licence, afin de fournir et d’améliorer les produits et services liés à la localisation et à la circulation routière.

Vous pouvez choisir à tout moment de désactiver le service de localisation. Pour cela, ouvrez Réglages, touchez Confidentialité puis « Service de localisation », puis désactivez le commutateur global « Service de localisation » ou désactivez le commutateur de localisation de chaque application ou fonctionnalité utilisant les données de localisation en le positionnant sur « Jamais ». Pour désactiver le service de localisation pour tous les sites web, réglez le service de localisation de Safari sur « Jamais ». Vous pouvez aussi désactiver les services système liés à la localisation en touchant « Services système » et en désactivant le commutateur pour chacun des services système liés à la localisation.

Si vous autorisez les apps ou sites web de tierce partie à utiliser votre position géographique, vous vous conformez à leurs conditions générales, à leurs pratiques et à leurs engagements en matière de confidentialité. Il est recommandé de consulter les conditions générales, les engagements en matière de confidentialité et les pratiques des apps ou sites web en question afin de comprendre comment ils utilisent vos informations de localisation et autres.

Les informations recueillies par Apple seront traitées conformément à l’Engagement de confidentialité d’Apple, que vous pouvez consulter à l’adresse www.apple.com/fr/privacy.

En app kan for eksempel bruke stedsinformasjon og stedssøk for å finne lokale kaféer eller kinoer, eller iPaden kan angi tidssonen automatisk etter posisjonen din. For å bruke disse funksjonene må du aktivere Stedstjenester på iPaden og gi hver enkel app og hver nettsted tillatelse før de kan bruke posisjonen din. Apper kan be om begrenset tilgang (kun når du bruker appen) eller full tilgang (selv når du ikke bruker appen) til stedsinformasjonen din. Av sikkerhetsgrunner kan stedsinformasjon fra iPaden din brukes når du ringer nødnummeret, så posisjonen din kan avgjøres selv når Stedstjenester er deaktivert.

  • Navigering og trafikk.  Hvis du er i fysisk bevegelse (for eksempel når du går eller kjører i bil), vil iPaden jevnlig sende anonyme og krypterte GPS-posisjoner og informasjon om kjørehastighet til Apple.   • Relevante steder.  iPaden registrerer hvor du har vært i det siste, i tillegg til når og hvor ofte du besøker stedet, slik at den lærer hvilke steder som er av betydning for deg. Dataene overføres med gjennomgående kryptering mellom enhetene dine som er koblet sammen via iCloud, og de vil ikke bli delt uten ditt samtykke. Informasjon brukes til å tilby deg personlige tjenester, som foreslåtte kjøreruter, og for å sette sammen bedre bildeminner.

Location Services allows Apple and third-party apps and websites to gather and use information based on the current location of your iPad to provide a variety of location-based services. For example, an app might use your location data and location search query to help you find nearby coffee shops or theaters, or your iPad may set its time zone automatically based on your current location. To use features such as these, you must enable Location Services on your iPad and give your permission to each app or website before it can use your location data. Apps may request limited access to your location data (only when you are using the app) or full access (even when you are not using the app). For safety purposes, however, your iPad’s location information may be used when you place an emergency call to aid response efforts regardless of whether you enable Location Services.

Location Services uses GPS and Bluetooth (where those are available) along with crowd-sourced %2$@ hotspot and cell tower locations to determine your iPad’s approximate location. If Location Services is on, your iPad will periodically send the geo-tagged locations of nearby %2$@ hotspots and cell towers in an anonymous and encrypted form to Apple, to be used for augmenting this crowd-sourced database of %2$@ hotspot and cell tower locations. By enabling Location Services, location-based system services such as these will also be enabled:

  • Routing & Traffic.  If you are physically moving (for example, walking or traveling in a car), your iPad will periodically send GPS locations and travel speed information in an anonymous and encrypted form to Apple. This crowd-sourced data is used to provide services such as real time traffic display and routing.
  • Popular Near Me.  Your iPad will periodically send locations of where, and when, you have purchased or used Apps in an anonymous and encrypted form to Apple, to improve a crowd-sourced database that may be used to offer geographically-relevant Apps and other Apple products and services.
  • Significant Locations.  Your iPad will keep track of places you have recently been, as well as how often and when you visited them, in order to learn places that are significant to you. This data is transmitted end-to-end encrypted between your iCloud connected devices and will not be shared without your consent. It will be used to provide you with personalized services, such as predictive traffic routing, and to build better Photos Memories.
  • Location-Based Apple Ads.  Your iPad will send your location, including its travel speed and direction, to Apple in order to provide you with geographically relevant iAds.
  • Location-Based Suggestions.  The location of your iPad will be sent to Apple to provide more relevant recommendations. If you turn off Location Services for Location-based Suggestions, your precise location will not be sent to Apple. To deliver relevant search suggestions and news, Apple may use the IP address of your internet connection to approximate your location by matching it to a geographic region.
  • Location-Based Alerts.  Your iPad will use your location in order to provide you with geographically-relevant alerts, such as a reminder to call someone when you get to a specific place, when to leave for your next appointment, or an app recommendation based on where you currently are.
  • Share My Location.  You can choose to share your current location with others, on a temporary or ongoing basis, from within certain apps such as Messages and Find My Friends.
  • HomeKit. Your iPad will use your location to enable accessories to turn on or off when you arrive or leave a specific location, such as turning on your lights when you get home.

The crowd-sourced location data gathered by Apple does not personally identify you.

By enabling Location Services on your iPad, you agree and consent to the transmission, collection, maintenance, processing, and use of your location data and location search queries by Apple and its partners and licensees to provide and improve location-based and road traffic-based products and services.

You may choose to disable Location Services at any time. To do so, open Settings, tap Privacy, tap Location Services, and either turn off the global Location Services switch or turn off the individual location switch of each location-aware app or feature on your iPad by setting it to “Never”. To disable Location Services for all websites, set the Location Services setting for Safari to “Never”. You may also disable location-based system services on your iPad by tapping on System Services and turning off the switch for each location-based system service on your iPad.

If you allow third-party apps or websites to use your current location, you are subject to their terms and privacy policy and practices. You should review the terms, privacy policies, and practices of such apps and websites to understand how they use your location and other information.

Information collected by Apple will be treated in accordance with Apple’s Privacy Policy, which can be found at www.apple.com/privacy.

「定位服務」讓Apple及第三方App與網站收集並使用基於iPad目前位置的資料，以便提供多種基於位置的服務。例如，App可能會使用你的位置資料及搜尋查詢來協助你尋找附近的咖啡店或戲院，iPad又或可能會根據你目前位置自動設定時區。如要使用這些功能，你必須啟用iPad上的「定位服務」並授權App或網站使用你的位置資料。App可能會要求有限制地取用（使用App時）或無限制地取用（使用或未使用App時）你的位置資料。為了安全，無論是否已啟用「定位服務」，iPad的位置資料都有可能在打緊急電話時用以協助救援。

「定位服務」使用GPS及藍牙（如可用）、眾包%2$@熱點及基地台的所在位置來確認iPad的大概位置。如已啟用「定位服務」，iPad會定期將附近%2$@熱點與基地台的地理座標位置，以匿名及加密的格式傳送至Apple，以加強%2$@熱點與基地台位置的眾包資料庫功能。如啟用了「定位服務」，也會啟用下列基於位置的系統服務：

  • 路線與路況。  如你正在移動（例如在行路或在車上），iPad會定期將GPS位置及路上移動速度，以匿名及加密的格式傳送至Apple。此眾包資料會用來提供即時路況及路線等服務。
  • 附近的熱門App。  iPad會定期將你購買或使用App的地點及時間，以匿名及加密的格式傳送給Apple，以改進用來提供地理相關App及其他Apple產品與服務的眾包資料庫。
  • 重要位置。  iPad會記錄你最近去過的地點及有關頻率和時間，以了解對你重要的地點。有關資料會在你的iCloud連線裝置間以點對點加密方式傳送，未經你同意不會作任何分享。有關資料將用作提供你個人化的服務，例如預測交通路線和製作更佳的「相片」回憶。

Za korištenje ovakvih značajki trebate uključiti Lokacijske usluge na svom iPad uređaju i dati svoje dopuštenje za svaku aplikaciju ili web stranicu kako bi ona mogla koristiti vaše lokacijske podatke. Ovi agregirani podaci koriste se za pružanje usluga poput prikazivanja stanja na cestama i ruta u realnom vremenu.

  • HomeKit. iPad će koristiti vašu lokaciju za omogućavanje uključivanja ili isključivanja pribora kad stignete ili napustite određenu lokaciju, primjerice, za uključenje svjetla kad stignete doma.

Konum Servisleri, Apple’ın ve üçüncü parti uygulamaların ve web sitelerinin konum tabanlı birçok hizmeti sağlaması için iPad’inizin şu anki konumunu baz alan bilgileri toplamasını ve kullanmasını sağlar. Örneğin bir uygulama yakındaki kafeleri veya sinemaları bulmanıza yardımcı olmak için konum verilerinizi ve konum arama sorgularını kullanabilir ya da iPad’iniz, saat dilimini şu anki konumunuza göre otomatik olarak ayarlayabilir. Bunun gibi özellikleri kullanmak için iPad’inizde Konum Servisleri’ni etkinleştirmeniz ve her bir uygulamaya veya web sitesine de konum verilerinizi kullanma izni vermeniz gerekir. Uygulamalar konum verilerinize sınırlı erişim (yalnızca uygulamayı kullanırken) veya tam erişim (uygulamayı kullanmıyorken bile) isteyebilir. Ancak güvenlik nedeniyle, Konum Servisleri’ni etkinleştirip etkinleştirmemenize bağlı olmaksızın yardım çalışmalarına katkıda bulunmak amacıyla iPad’inizin konum bilgileri acil arama yaptığınızda kullanılabilir.

Konum Servisleri, iPad’inizin yaklaşık konumunu belirlemek için kitle kaynaklı %2$@ erişim noktası ve baz istasyonu konumlarıyla GPS’i ve Bluetooth’u (kullanılabiliyorsa) kullanır. Konum Servisleri açıksa; iPad’iniz, %2$@ erişim noktası ve baz istasyonu konumlarının bu kitle kaynaklı veri tabanını büyütmek için yakındaki %2$@ erişim noktalarının ve hücre kulelerinin coğrafi etiketli konumlarını anonim olarak ve şifrelenmiş bir biçimde düzenli aralıklarla Apple’a gönderecektir. Konum Servisleri etkinleştirildiğinde şunun gibi konum tabanlı sistem servisleri de etkinleştirilecektir:

  • Yönlendirme ve Trafik.  Fiziksel olarak hareket halindeyseniz (örneğin yürüyorsanız veya arabada seyahat ediyorsanız), iPad’iniz, GPS konumlarını ve yoldaki seyahat hızı bilgilerini anonim olarak ve şifrelenmiş bir biçimde düzenli aralıklarla Apple’a gönderecektir. Bu kitle kaynaklı veriler, gerçek zamanlı trafik görüntüleme ve yönlendirme gibi servisleri sağlamak için kullanılır.
  • Yakınımda Popüler.  iPad’iniz, coğrafi olarak ilgili uygulamaları ve diğer Apple ürünlerini ve servislerini sunmak için kullanılabilecek kitle kaynaklı veri tabanını iyileştirmek için uygulamaları satın aldığınız veya kullandığınız yerlerin konumlarını ve ne zaman satın alındıklarını anonim olarak ve şifrelenmiş bir biçimde düzenli aralıklarla Apple’a gönderecektir.
  • Önemli Konumlar.  iPad’iniz sizin için önemli yerleri öğrenmek amacıyla yakın zamanda ziyaret ettiğiniz yerleri ve bunları ne zaman ve hangi sıklıkta ziyaret ettiğinizi takip edecektir. Bu veriler, iCloud’a bağlı aygıtlarınız arasında uçtan uca şifrelenerek aktarılır ve onayınız olmadan paylaşılmaz. La localización permite que las apps y los sitios web de Apple o de terceros recopilen y usen información basada en la ubicación actual del iPad para poder ofrecer varios servicios basados en la ubicación. Por ejemplo, una app puede usar tus datos de ubicación o tus búsquedas de ubicación para ayudarte a encontrar una cafetería o un teatro cercanos, o el iPad puede ajustar la zona horaria automáticamente en función de tu ubicación. Para tener acceso a estas funciones, debes activar la localización en el iPad y dar tu autorización a cada app o sitio web antes de que use tus datos de ubicación. Las apps pueden tener acceso limitado a tus datos de ubicación (solo cuando estés usando la app en cuestión) o tener acceso total (incluso si no la estás utilizando en esos momentos). No obstante, por motivos de seguridad, puede que la información de ubicación del iPad se use cuando realices una llamada de emergencia con el fin de facilitar el socorro, independientemente de si la localización está activada o no.

La localización usa GPS y Bluetooth (si están disponibles), junto con datos de antenas de telefonía móvil y puntos de acceso activos %2$@, para determinar la ubicación aproximada de tu iPad. Si la localización está activada, el iPad enviará periódicamente a Apple las ubicaciones geográficas de las antenas de telefonía móvil y los puntos de acceso activos %2$@ cercanos, de manera anónima y encriptada, para alimentar la base de datos de las ubicaciones de las antenas de telefonía móvil y los puntos de acceso activos %2$@. Al activar la localización, también se activarán funciones del sistema basadas en la ubicación como las siguientes:

  • Navegación y tráfico. Si estás en movimiento (por ejemplo, si estás andando o estás en un coche), el iPad enviará periódicamente a Apple, de manera anónima y encriptada, ubicaciones de GPS e información acerca de la velocidad en carretera. Estos datos se utilizan para proporcionar servicios como la ruta y la visualización del tráfico en tiempo real.
  • Populares cerca. El iPad enviará periódicamente a Apple, de manera anónima y encriptada, información sobre dónde y cuándo hayas adquirido o utilizado apps, para mejorar una base de datos que servirá para ofrecer apps relevantes geográficamente, así como otros productos y servicios de Apple.
  • Lugares importantes. El iPad registrará los sitios en los que hayas estado, así como las fechas y las veces que los hayas visitado, para poder aprender qué sitios son importantes para ti. Estos datos se transmiten con encriptación punto a punto entre los dispositivos que tienes conectados a iCloud y no se compartirán sin tu consentimiento. Se utilizarán para proporcionarte servicios personalizados como, por ejemplo, rutas de tráfico predictivas, y para crear mejores recuerdos en Fotos.
  • Anuncios de Apple según la ubicación. El iPad enviará a Apple tu ubicación, junto con la velocidad y la dirección que lleves, para poder proporcionarte iAds pertinentes geográficamente.
  • Sugerencias según la ubicación. La ubicación del iPad se enviará a Apple con el fin de proporcionarte recomendaciones más pertinentes. Si desactivas la localización para las sugerencias según la ubicación, no se enviará a Apple tu ubicación exacta. No obstante, para poder proporcionarte sugerencias de búsqueda y noticias pertinentes, Apple podrá utilizar la dirección IP de tu conexión a internet para deducir tu ubicación aproximada en una zona geográfica.
  • Avisos según ubicación. El iPad utilizará tu ubicación para proporcionarte avisos relevantes geográficamente, como por ejemplo, un recordatorio para que llames a alguien al llegar a un determinado lugar, la hora a la que debes partir para ir a tu siguiente cita o una recomendación de una app, en función de dónde te encuentras actualmente.
  • Compartir mi ubicación. Puedes compartir tu ubicación actual con otras personas, ya sea de forma temporal o permanente, desde determinadas apps, como Mensajes o Buscar a mis Amigos.
  • HomeKit. El iPad utilizará tu ubicación para que los accesorios puedan encenderse o apagarse cuando llegues o te vayas de una determinada ubicación (por ejemplo, que se enciendan las luces cuando llegues a casa).

Los datos de ubicación recopilados por Apple se obtienen sin identificarte personalmente.
